The first step is course A.
Course A is called 'Conquer the Desert!'.
It's the most proper mission for your level.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
第一階段是A課程。
A課程叫做“征服沙漠！”。
這是最適合你等級的任務。

scripts.text:
[Boya]
I'll send you to the first step of course B.
Course B is called 'Conquer the Culvert!'.
It's the most proper mission for your level.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
我會把你送到B課程的第一階段。
B課程叫做“征服下水道！”。
這是最適合你等級的任務。

scripts.text: [Boya]
scripts.translation: [博雅]

scripts.text:
[Boya]
^4d4dffThere is a desert town called Morocc.
From there go south and then east. There is small oasis in the center of that field.^000000
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
^4d4dff有一個叫莫羅克的沙漠城鎮。
從那裡往南走，再往東走。在那片平原的中心有一個小綠洲。^000000

scripts.text:
[Boya]
If you go there, you will find a dog around the oasis.
He is really mysterious and he can speak so don't be suprised.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
如果你去那裡，會在綠洲附近發現一隻狗。
它非常神秘，而且會說話，所以請不要感到驚訝。

scripts.text:
[Boya]
Tell the dog ^4d4dffBoya is really great.^000000
If you have any questions ask that dog.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
告訴那隻狗^4d4dff博雅真的很棒。^000000
如果你有任何問題，就問那隻狗。

scripts.text:
[Boya]
Why are you staring at me?
I had to come up with a password right?
What's wrong with that password?
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
你為什麼盯著我看？
我不得不想一個密碼，對吧？
這個密碼有什麼問題嗎？

scripts.text:
[Boya]
Anyway, that place is not far from here so, it is a reasonable place for a beginner like you.
Ok, may Freya bless you~!
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
總之，那個地方離這裡不遠，所以對於像你這樣的初學者來說是個合理的地方。
好了，願弗蕾雅保佑你~！

scripts.text:
[Boya]
You need to register to explore the culvert in Prontera at the Knight Guild.
After registering there go to the western gate of Prontera. The manager of the culvert is near the entrance.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
你需要在普隆德拉的騎士公會登記，才能探索普隆德拉的下水道。
登記後，前往普隆德拉的西門。下水道的管理員就在入口附近。

scripts.text:
[Boya]
Once you enter the culvert you can find a dispatched cat. Don't be surprised if he talks to you.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
一旦進入下水道，你會發現一隻被派遣的貓。如果它跟你說話，請不要感到驚訝。

scripts.text:
[Boya]
Tell the cat ^4d4dffBoya's help is like a giant and beautiful tuna^000000.
He is really mysterious and he can speak so don't be suprised.
He will give you a battle target when you tell him that.
If you have any questions ask the cat.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
告訴那隻貓^4d4dff博雅的幫助就像一條巨大而美麗的金槍魚。^000000
它非常神秘，而且會說話，所以請不要感到驚訝。
當你告訴它這句話時，它會給你一個戰鬥目標。
如果你有任何問題，就問那隻貓。

scripts.text:
[Boya]
Why are you staring at me like that?
It's just a password that I made up.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
你為什麼那樣盯著我看？
這只是我編的一個密碼而已。

scripts.text:
[Boya]
Anyway...
That place is nor far from here so, it is a reasonable place for a beginner like you.
Ok, may Freya bless you~!
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
總之...
那個地方離這裡不遠，所以對於像你這樣的初學者來說是個合理的地方。
好了，願弗蕾雅保佑你~！

scripts.text:
Cool.
Let me choose a proper place for you.
scripts.translation:
酷。
讓我為你選擇一個合適的地方。

scripts.text:
[Boya]
I'll send you to the second step of course A.
This course is called 'Conquer the Ghost Cave!'.
It's the most proper mission for your level.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
我會把你送到A課程的第二階段。
這個課程叫做“征服幽靈洞穴！”。
這是最適合你等級的任務。

scripts.text:
[Boya]
There is a small archer village north of Payon.
There is a cave on the western hill of the archer village.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
在斐揚的北邊有一個小弓箭手村。
在弓箭手村西邊的山丘上有一個洞穴。

scripts.text:
[Boya]
We have dispatched someone in front of the cave.
His name is... um...
...
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
我們在洞穴前派了人。
他的名字是...嗯...
...

scripts.text:
[Boya]
Anyway he is one of us so he will know me.
He will give you a mission.
If you have questions ask him.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
總之，他是我們的人，所以他會認識我。
他會給你一個任務。
如果你有問題，就問他。

scripts.text:
[Boya]
Why are you staring at me?
We haven't met for a long time that's why I can't remember his name!
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
你為什麼盯著我看？
因為我們很久沒見了，所以我記不起他的名字了！

scripts.text:
[Boya]
Anyway...
That place is not far from here so, come back quickly.
Ok, may Freya bless you~!
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
總之...
那個地方離這裡不遠，所以請快點回來。
好了，願弗蕾雅保佑你~！

scripts.text:
I'll send you to the 2nd step of course B.
This course is called 'Conquer Anthell!'.
It's the most proper mission for your level.
scripts.translation:
我會把你送到B課程的第二階段。
這個課程叫做“征服蟻穴！”。
這是最適合你等級的任務。

scripts.text:
[Boya]
Travel just southwest of Morocc City.
There you will find a hole in the ground to a cave called Anthell.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
前往莫羅克城的西南方。
在那裡你會發現一個通往名為蟻穴的洞穴的地洞。

scripts.text:
[Boya]
There are lots of ants in there. kk?
It is also covered in sand so be careful in there ok.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
那裡有很多螞蟻。呵呵？
裡面也覆蓋著沙子，所以請小心，好嗎。

scripts.text:
[Boya]
That's why it's called ant hell.
One of our members will be waiting there.
His name is... K? M? Hmm? Anyway I can't remember.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
所以那裡被稱為螞蟻地獄。
我們的一位成員會在那裡等你。
他的名字是...K？M？嗯？總之我想不起來了。

scripts.text:
[Boya]
He is one of us so he will know me.
He will give you a mission.
If you have any questions ask him.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
他是我們的成員，所以他會認識我。
他會給你釋出任務。
如果你有任何問題，問他就好。

scripts.text:
[Boya]
Why are you staring at me?
We haven't met for a long time that's why I can't remember his name!
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
你為什麼盯著我看？
因為我們很久沒見了，所以我記不起他的名字了！

scripts.text:
[Boya]
Anyway...
That place is not far from here so, come back quickly.
Ok, blessing you~!!
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
總之...
那個地方離這裡不遠，所以請快點回來。
好了，願弗蕾雅保佑你~！

scripts.text:
You are on the third step of course A.
This course is called 'Conquer Orc village!'.
Let me see...
scripts.translation:
你正在A課程的第三階段。
這個課程叫做“征服獸人村！”。
讓我看看...

scripts.text:
[Boya]
Go through the gate of Prontera and keep walking to the west. Orc Village is in that direction.
Or you can go out through the western gate of Geffen and keep heading southeast..
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
穿過普隆德拉的大門，一直向西走。獸人村就在那個方向。
或者你也可以從吉芬的西門出去，一直向東南方前進。

scripts.text:
[Boya]
Umm. Orc village has a Kafra Employee dispatched there so you could use the Kafra services..
It's up to you.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
嗯。獸人村有一位卡普拉 職員駐紮在那裡，所以你可以使用卡普拉服務。
這取決於你自己。

scripts.text:
[Boya]
One of our dispatched members is waiting in the building near the Kafra Employee.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
我們派出的成員正在卡普拉職員附近的建築物裡等你。

scripts.text:
[Boya]
She will explain what needs to be done there.
If you have any questions ask her.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
她會解釋在那裡需要做什麼。
如果你有任何問題，問她就好。

scripts.text:
[Boya]
Ok, may Freya bless you!
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
好了，願弗蕾雅保佑你！

scripts.text:
You are on the third step of course B.
This course is called 'Conquer Orc dungeon!'.
It's the most proper mission for your level.
scripts.translation:
你正在B課程的第三階段。
這個課程叫做“征服獸人地下城！”。
這是最適合你等級的任務。

scripts.text:

Go through the gate of Prontera and keep walking to the west. Orc Village is in that direction.

scripts.translation:

穿過普隆德拉的大門，一直向西走。獸人村就在那個方向。
或者你也可以從吉芬的西門出去，一直向東南方前進。

scripts.text:

Umm. Orc village has a Kafra Employee dispatched there so you could use the Kafra services..
It's up to you.

她會解釋在那裡需要做什麼。

scripts.text:
[Boya]
Ok, may Freya bless you!
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
好了，願弗蕾雅保佑你！

scripts.text:
You are on the last step.
This course is called 'Conquer the Ocean City!'.
I don't know if it is the proper course or not, but anyway it's the last course of our training.
scripts.translation:
你正在最後一個階段。
這個課程叫做“征服海洋城市！”。
我不知道這是否是最合適的課程，但總之這是我們訓練的最後一課。

scripts.text:
[Boya]
First take a ship to Byalan Island from Izlude!
There is an underground cave. Go in and get to the bottom floor where you will find a historic underwater city..
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
首先從依斯魯得島乘船前往拜蘭島！
那裡有一個地下洞穴。進去併到達最底層，你會在那裡發現一座歷史悠久的水下城市。

scripts.text:
[Boya]
Although it's underwater, you can breath so don't worry.
There is a dispatched trainee around the entrance of the Ocean City.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
雖然是在水下，但你可以呼吸，所以不用擔心。
在海洋城市的入口附近有一位駐紮的學員。

scripts.text:
[Boya]
Tell him that I sent you and follow his directions.
Ok, may Freya bless you!
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
告訴他是我派你來的，並按照他的指示行動。
好了，願弗蕾雅保佑你！

scripts.text:
[Talking Dog]
kkkkuuuuahhh.
rrrrrruuuuhh.
bowwow..
scripts.translation:
[會說話的狗]
kkkkuuuuahhh.
rrrrrruuuuhh.
bowwow..

scripts.text:
[Talking Dog]
What's up?
You are!
A member of the Eden Group.
Have you come to give me a meal? I don't like drinks.
scripts.translation:
[會說話的狗]
怎麼了？
是你啊！
樂園團的成員。
你是來給我送飯的嗎？我不喜歡喝飲料。

scripts.text: Boya is really perfect.
scripts.translation: 博雅真的很完美。

scripts.text: Boya is really great.
scripts.translation: 博雅真的很棒。

scripts.text: Boya is really soft.
scripts.translation: 博雅真的很溫柔。

scripts.text:
[Talking Dog]
Uhh...
What are you saying.
scripts.translation:
[會說話的狗]
呃...
你在說什麼。

scripts.text:
[Talking Dog]
Ahh... um...
Gosh, did you come here to participate in the training?
If Boya sent you then you know that it's battle training.
Bow wow...
scripts.translation:
[會說話的狗]
啊...嗯...
天哪，你是來參加訓練的嗎？
如果是博雅派你來的，那你應該知道這是戰鬥訓練。
Bow wow...

scripts.text:
[Talking Dog]
If so, should I start securing this oasis more clearly?
Can you see a Condor flying?
scripts.translation:
[會說話的狗]
如果是這樣，我應該更徹底地保護這片綠洲嗎？
你能看到禿鷹在飛嗎？

scripts.text:
[Talking Dog]
Can you scare them away for me?
So people can use this oasis safer and more comfortably.
scripts.translation:
[會說話的狗]
你能幫我把它們趕走嗎？
這樣大家使用這片綠洲時就能更安全、更舒適了。

scripts.text:
[Talking Dog]
We should hunt at least 10 Condors, ok?
I will sleep for a while.
Krrrr woo bow...
scripts.translation:
[會說話的狗]
我們要至少獵殺10只禿鷹，好嗎？
我要睡一會兒。
Krrrr woo bow...

scripts.text:
[Talking Dog]
Are you ok?
Haven't you seen a talking dog before?
What are you talking about?
scripts.translation:
[會說話的狗]
你沒事吧？
你以前沒見過會說話的狗嗎？
你在說什麼？

scripts.text:
[Talking Dog]
Woooohh...
Great!
I can feel my youth from you.
scripts.translation:
[會說話的狗]
Woooohh...
太棒了！
我能從你身上感受到青春的氣息。

scripts.text:
[Talking Dog]
Nevermind.
Let's find the next target kk!
Ok. Let's drive the Desert Wolves out of here.
scripts.translation:
[會說話的狗]
算了。
讓我們去找下一個目標吧！
好的，讓我們把沙漠狼趕出去。

scripts.text:
[Talking Dog]
If they grow up they will become dangerous.
......
scripts.translation:
[會說話的狗]
如果它們長大了，會變得很危險。
......

scripts.text:
[Talking Dog]
Why, why are you looking at me like that?
They are wolves and I am a nice dog.
But I haven't always been a dog my entire life.
scripts.translation:
[會說話的狗]
為什麼，你為什麼那樣看著我？
它們是狼，而我是隻善良的狗。
但我並不是一輩子都是狗。

scripts.text:
[Talking Dog]
I will show you that don't have to pity me at all.
scripts.translation:
[會說話的狗]
我會向你證明，你完全不需要同情我。

scripts.text:
[Talking Dog]
They pee wherever and have no shame.
Just waving their tails when they grow up and biting people without any care!
scripts.translation:
[會說話的狗]
它們隨地大小便，毫無羞恥之心。
長大後只會搖著尾巴，不管不顧地咬人！

scripts.text:
[Talking Dog]
You must hunt at least 10!
Exactly 10!
Go go go!
scripts.translation:
[會說話的狗]
你必須至少獵殺10只！
正好10只！
快去吧快去吧！

scripts.text:
[Talking Dog]
First lets follow the bald and noisy bird.
Yes Condors.
Kill 10 Condors. It seems to easy, right?
Oh, if you are tired I will help you.
scripts.translation:
[會說話的狗]
首先讓我們跟著那些禿頭且吵鬧的鳥。
是的，禿鷹。
獵殺10只禿鷹。看起來很容易，對吧？
哦，如果你累了，我會幫你的。

scripts.text: -When the dog barked, your HP and SP recovered.-
scripts.translation: -當狗吠叫時，你的HP和SP恢復了。-

scripts.text:
[Talking Dog]
You are so perfect.
scripts.translation:
[會說話的狗]
你真的很完美。

scripts.text:
[Talking Dog]
Or not. Hehe, anyway thanks for your help.
The oasis has almost been secured now.
Ok, it's the last step!
scripts.translation:
[會說話的狗]
或者不是。呵呵，不管怎樣，謝謝你的幫助。
綠洲現在幾乎安全了。
好的，這是最後一步！

scripts.text:
[Talking Dog]
There's an annoying monster that hides in the sand and poisons people out of nowhere.
scripts.translation:
[會說話的狗]
有一種討厭的魔物，躲在沙子裡，從背後毒害人們。

scripts.text:
[Talking Dog]
All beautiful things have some poison inside but these actually kill.
Kill Scorpions which are called the poison of the desert!
scripts.translation:
[會說話的狗]
所有美麗的東西內部都帶有一些毒素，但這些真的會致命。
獵殺被稱為沙漠之毒的蠍子！

scripts.text:
[Talking Dog]
It's the last step so let's make it simple
Just hunt 5!
Bow wow!
scripts.translation:
[會說話的狗]
這是最後一步，讓我們簡單點
只需獵殺5只！
Bow wow!

scripts.text:
[Talking Dog]
I don't want you to show any pity.
I am dog with a golden heart.
scripts.translation:
[會說話的狗]
我不想讓你表現出任何同情。
我是隻擁有金子般心靈的狗。

scripts.text:
[Talking Dog]
After hunting the 10 Desert Wolves come back again.
Oh, if you are tired I will help you.
scripts.translation:
[會說話的狗]
獵殺10只沙漠狼後，再回來。
哦，如果你累了，我會幫你的。

scripts.text: -When the dog barked, your HP and SP recovered.-
scripts.translation: -當狗吠叫時，你的HP和SP恢復了。-

scripts.text:
[Talking Dog]
Um. Excellent.
You are awesome!
scripts.translation:
[會說話的狗]
嗯。太棒了。
你真是厲害！

scripts.text:
[Talking Dog]
Thanks to your effort the oasis is secure.
Don't look around!
If I say it's secure!
Uhuhuhuh aaaang!
scripts.translation:
[會說話的狗]
多虧了你的努力，綠洲已經安全了。
別東張西望！
我說安全了就是安全了！
嗚呼呼呼 啊啊啊！

scripts.text:
[Talking Dog]
Here here here.
If I dig more and more, I can find Scorpions but
this oasis will be safer for sure.
scripts.translation:
[會說話的狗]
這裡這裡這裡。
如果我再多挖一點，就能找到蠍子了，
但這樣綠洲肯定更安全。

scripts.text:
[Talking Dog]
You can be proud and confident by yourself and do your best.
You've helped a lot to make my rest comfortable.
scripts.translation:
[會說話的狗]
你可以為自己感到驕傲和自信，並做到最好。
你為我的休息提供了很大的幫助。

scripts.text:
[Talking Dog]
You've helped to conquer the desert,
and passed the beginner training steps so I will stamp my feet.
krrrrreuung. hup.
scripts.translation:
[會說話的狗]
你幫助征服了沙漠，
並通過了新手訓練步驟，所以我要跺跺腳。
咔咔咔咔咔。呼。

scripts.text:
[Talking Dog]
Go back to the Eden Group headquarters and show it to the flashy Rune Knight.
Let me say again that you are great!
Hooooohooo~
scripts.translation:
[會說話的狗]
回到樂園團總部，把它展示給那位華麗的盧恩騎士看。
讓我再說一遍，你太棒了！
呼哦呼哦~

scripts.text:
[Talking Dog]
Let's hunt only 5 Scorpions.
So we can make peace in this oasis.
scripts.translation:
[會說話的狗]
我們只獵殺5只蠍子。
這樣我們就能在這個綠洲實現和平了。

scripts.text:
[Talking Dog]
When I take a nap they won't chew my tail any more.
Due to his mistake my feet won't be hurt at all.
scripts.translation:
[會說話的狗]
當我小睡時，它們就不會再咬我的尾巴了。
由於他的失誤，我的腳完全不會受傷。

scripts.text:
[Talking Dog]
You can fight.
I can rest more comfortably.
Other people are going to be safer too.
scripts.translation:
[會說話的狗]
你可以戰鬥。
我可以更舒適地休息。
其他人也會更安全。

scripts.text:
[Talking Dog]
Everyone will think fondly of the Eden Group.
Oh, if you are tired I will help you.
scripts.translation:
[會說話的狗]
每個人都會對樂園團留下美好的印象。
哦，如果你累了，我會幫你的。

scripts.text: -When the dog barked, your HP and SP recovered.-
scripts.translation: -當狗吠叫時，你的HP和SP恢復了。-

scripts.text:
[Talking Dog]
kkkkkaaaaauuuunnng.
oopssss kup.
scripts.translation:
[會說話的狗]
咔咔咔咔咔。
哎呀 撲通。

scripts.text:
[Talking Dog]
Why are you still here?
You are done here.
Hooooo bow wow.
scripts.translation:
[會說話的狗]
你為什麼還在這裡？
你在這裡的任務已經完成了。
呼哦 汪汪。

scripts.text:
[Talking Dog]
Hey man~ What's going on?
What about the Rune Knight?
Krrrrr...
Hyuk huk...
scripts.translation:
[會說話的狗]
嘿，夥計~ 發生什麼事了？
盧恩騎士怎麼樣了？
咔咔咔...
嘿 呼...

scripts.text:
[Talking Dog]
The Eden Group is cool.
They're a really good group.
They accepted a wandering talking dog.
Take care and good luck.
scripts.translation:
[會說話的狗]
樂園團很酷。
他們真的是個很好的團體。
他們接納了一隻流浪的會說話的狗。
保重，祝你好運。

scripts.text:
Hey look.
I'm a talking dog.
Not a wolf.
I wasn't a dog originally...
scripts.translation:
嘿，看這裡。
我是會說話的狗。
不是狼。
我原本並不是狗...

scripts.text:
[Talking Dog]
Anyway are you a Eden Group member?
Oh good to see you.
I am also a member of Eden Group.
Take care and good luck.
scripts.translation:
[會說話的狗]
不管怎樣，你是樂園團的成員嗎？
哦，很高興見到你。
我也是樂園團的成員。
保重，祝你好運。

scripts.text:
[Talking Dog]
Why are you looking at me like that?
......
scripts.translation:
[會說話的狗]
你為什麼那樣看著我？
......

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
Meow...
Who are you meow?
Why are you here meow?
scripts.translation:
[膽小的貓]
喵...
你是誰喵？
你為什麼在這裡喵？

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
Come on meow...
I may be standing here and talking to you like this meow but I am a still a cat meow...
scripts.translation:
[膽小的貓]
拜託喵...
我雖然站在這裡和你說話喵，但我仍然是一隻貓喵...

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
Dear human you are
a member of my group?
Re... really...!
Dear Boya's help is like a giant and...
scripts.translation:
[膽小的貓]
親愛的人類，你是
我團體的成員嗎？
真...真的嗎...！
親愛的博雅的幫助就像巨人一樣...

scripts.text: Beautiful Saury
scripts.translation: 漂亮的秋刀魚

scripts.text: Fresh Mackerel
scripts.translation: 新鮮的鯖魚

scripts.text: Beautiful Tuna
scripts.translation: 漂亮的大金槍魚

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
Big and beautiful Saury...
I am shy.
scripts.translation:
[膽小的貓]
又大又漂亮的秋刀魚...
我有點害羞。

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
I want to eat mackerel.
Where are the big and fresh mackerel meow?
scripts.translation:
[膽小的貓]
我想吃鯖魚。
又大又新鮮的鯖魚在哪裡喵？

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
Do you know the big and beautiful tuna?
Dear Boya sent you here for sure.
How do I explain this...?
scripts.translation:
[膽小的貓]
你知道又大又漂亮的大金槍魚嗎？
親愛的博雅一定是派你來的。
該怎麼說呢...？

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
Did something pass under my feet just now meow?
Do you want to kill a cat.
The environment here is terrible.
scripts.translation:
[膽小的貓]
剛才有什麼東西從我腳下跑過去了喵？
你想殺貓嗎？
這裡的環境太糟糕了。

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
Anyway I'm doing what I was assigned to do.
So hi, hello and welcome.
scripts.translation:
[膽小的貓]
不管怎樣，我正在執行分配給我的任務。
所以你好，歡迎。

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
Did you come here to have a battle?
Hunt those Thief Bugs, hurry up!
Hunt at least 10!
Meooow!
scripts.translation:
[膽小的貓]
你是來戰鬥的嗎？
去獵殺那些浮勒盜蟲，快點！
至少獵殺10只！
喵嗚！

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
I really don't like those nasty crawlers...
Meow~!
scripts.translation:
[膽小的貓]
我真的不喜歡那些噁心的爬蟲...
喵~！

scripts.text:
^4d4dffThe cat was suprised by
a thief bug and froze in
place. Hunt those
Thief Bugs around here.^000000
scripts.translation:
^4d4dff那隻貓被浮勒盜蟲嚇到了，
僵在原地。去獵殺
附近的浮勒盜蟲。^000000

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
Now do you understand the dirty and humid underground sewers?
Eeeh look what's next meow.
scripts.translation:
[膽小的貓]
現在你明白地下下水道有多髒多潮溼了嗎？
哎呀，看看接下來是什麼喵。

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
It's a symbol of dirt next to those Thief Bugs.
Hunt some Tarou to make the sewers cleaner.
scripts.translation:
[膽小的貓]
那是那些浮勒盜蟲旁邊的髒汙象徵。
獵殺一些白鼠，讓下水道變乾淨點。

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
For our members joining this mission.
Hunt 10 Tarou.
Easy, ain't it?
scripts.translation:
[膽小的貓]
對於加入這次任務的成員。
獵殺10只白鼠。
很簡單，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
Why didn't I ask you at once? kkk..??
Umm........
Because it's just a training mission.
scripts.translation:
[膽小的貓]
我為什麼沒一開始就問你呢？呵呵..??
嗯........
因為這只是一個訓練任務。

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
Training missions are hard and anoying.
So go hurry and hunt 10 Tarou.
scripts.translation:
[膽小的貓]
訓練任務既困難又麻煩。
所以快去獵殺10只白鼠。

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
Clean the sewers. Now the first step is hunting Thief Bugs.
Isn't that simple, meow?
scripts.translation:
[膽小的貓]
清理下水道。第一步是獵殺浮勒盜蟲。
很簡單，對吧，喵？

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
Take care to check your map so you don't get lost.
It's a service meeow.
scripts.translation:
[膽小的貓]
注意檢視地圖，別迷路了。
這是服務喵。

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
Great job~!
How'd you get rid of those dirty bugs and Tarou. You are brave.
scripts.translation:
[膽小的貓]
幹得好~！
你是怎麼除掉那些髒蟲和白鼠的。你真勇敢。

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
Now have courage because I'm sending you to a stronger opponent.
But first in order to test your courage, hunt Familiars.
scripts.translation:
[膽小的貓]
現在鼓起勇氣，我要派你去面對更強的對手。
但首先，為了測試你的勇氣，去獵殺使魔。

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
Familiars will bite you so be careful.
They are mean.
They scare me so just hunt 5 and that should be enough.
scripts.translation:
[膽小的貓]
使魔會咬人，所以要小心。
它們很兇的。
它們把我嚇壞了，所以只要獵殺5只就夠了。

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
That will show me that you are brave.
Meow~!
scripts.translation:
[膽小的貓]
這樣就能證明你很勇敢了。
喵~！

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
I don't have anything...
......
What do you want meow? Familiars are waiting to fight with you, hurry up, move~!
scripts.translation:
[膽小的貓]
我沒什麼要說的...
......
你想怎麼樣喵？使魔正等著和你戰鬥呢，快去吧，動起來~！

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
If you can't kill the Tarou you might get all kinds of dirty diseases.
So be proud of yourself and do your best to kill them.
scripts.translation:
[膽小的貓]
如果你殺不死白鼠，可能會染上各種骯髒的疾病。
所以要為自己感到驕傲，盡全力去消滅它們。

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
I will help you a little.
Here, I have recovered your strengh meow..
scripts.translation:
[膽小的貓]
我會幫點小忙。
看，我恢復了你的力量喵..

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
You are great meow~
You killed them so quickly!
Meow...
scripts.translation:
[膽小的貓]
你真棒喵~
你消滅它們的速度好快！
喵...

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
Now you are not scared of bugs and tarou at all.
Thanks for participating in the Conquer the Culvert training mission.
scripts.translation:
[膽小的貓]
現在你完全不怕蟲子和白鼠了。
感謝你參加“征服下水道”訓練任務。

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
Now go back to the headquarters and ask Instructor Boya to make sure he has the beautiful tuna...
I will be waiting here.
scripts.translation:
[膽小的貓]
現在回到總部，讓教官博雅確認他那裡有美味的金槍魚...
我會在這裡等著。

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
Do you know how to get to the Eden Group Headquarters?
Prontera is the closest city from here.
Go to Prontera and find an Eden Group Teleporter.
scripts.translation:
[膽小的貓]
你知道怎麼去樂園團總部嗎？
離這裡最近的城市是普隆德拉。
去普隆德拉找樂園團的傳送員。

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
Familiars are really scary.
They're always flying.
scripts.translation:
[膽小的貓]
使魔真的很可怕。
它們總是在飛。

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
It's the last course so cheer up.
I will help you a little.
Here, I have recovered your strengh meow..
scripts.translation:
[膽小的貓]
這是最後一關，加油。
我會幫點小忙。
看，我恢復了你的力量喵..

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
You've completed 'Conquer the Culvert'.
Go back to the Eden Group headquarters to report to Boya.
scripts.translation:
[膽小的貓]
你已完成“征服下水道”。
回到樂園團總部向博雅彙報。

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
Boya might eat my tuna while he is waiting for you.
scripts.translation:
[膽小的貓]
博雅可能會在你等待期間吃掉我的金槍魚。

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
How are you meeow?
Did you volunteer to conquer the Culvert?
You are a member of the Edgen Group for sure.
You are helping to make the world a better place.
scripts.translation:
[膽小的貓]
你好喵？
你是自願參加“征服下水道”任務的嗎？
你肯定是樂園團的成員。
你在幫助讓世界變得更美好。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Hey, how are you?
Good to see you~
Are you going inside?
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
嘿，你好嗎？
很高興見到你~
你要進去嗎？

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Umm...?
You are not the one I am waiting for.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
嗯...？
你不是我在等的人。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Hello?
Since I got a report, I was waiting for you.
You came here to join the training mission, right?
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
你好？
因為我收到了報告，所以一直在等你。
你是來參加訓練任務的，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Have you ever entered this cave before?
I don't know if you already heard some stories in this village.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
你以前進過這個洞穴嗎？
我不知道你是否已經在村裡聽到過一些傳聞。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
There are many of dead souls that change their appearance as if they are real people and make threatening remarks.
It's too bad, isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
這裡有很多亡魂，它們會偽裝成活人並做出威脅性的舉動。
真糟糕，不是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Karl]
That's why we chose this place as step 2 of the battle training mission.
This step is called 'Conquer Ghost Cave~'.
Help people to enjoy their nights comfortably.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
所以我們選擇這裡作為戰鬥訓練任務的第二步。
這一步叫做“征服幽靈洞穴~”。
幫助人們安享夜晚。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
There are many dangerous things there. Hmm...
To you the 1st floor is enough.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
那裡有很多危險的東西。嗯...
對你來說，第一層就足夠了。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Lets conquer the dangerous ghost cave...
Kill the bone Skeletons in there.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
讓我們征服這個危險的幽靈洞穴...
消滅裡面的邪骸戰士。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
The bones are from Skeletons.
Actually Skeletons or just normal bones are all the same but...
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
那些骨頭來自邪骸戰士。
其實邪骸戰士和普通骨頭沒什麼區別，但是...

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Skeletons are one of the basic undead classes.
Undead never ever. Hunt 15 undead Skeletons.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
邪骸戰士是基礎的亡靈類魔物。
亡靈永遠不會死亡。去獵殺15只邪骸戰士。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
If you feel like you're in danger don't hesitate to just leave.
You're not worried about getting hurt are you?
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
如果你覺得危險，不要猶豫，直接離開就好。
你不會擔心受傷吧？

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Did you get how the undead work?
As you know undead never die so, blessing of live person it's same as curse to them.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
你明白亡靈的特性了嗎？
如你所知，亡靈永遠不會死亡，所以活人的祝福對它們來說等同於詛咒。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
So... skills which can save people like Heal and Resurrection.
Those things are really strong attacks to undead class.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
所以...像治癒術和復活術這種能拯救人的技能。
對亡靈類魔物來說，這些其實是極強的攻擊。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Anyway... that's it..
Next... I guess you already see while you were killing Skeletons.
Some green things are picking up all of the stuff dropped by the dead monsters.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
總之...就是這樣。
接下來...我想你在殺邪骸戰士的時候已經看到了。
有些綠色的東西正在撿起死去的魔物掉落的物品。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Do you know Porings? Maybe they are related to them.
They look really bad, maybe they have been eating poison or something.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
你知道波利嗎？也許它們和波利有關。
它們看起來狀態很差，可能吃了什麼毒藥之類的東西。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Ok if you're ready go and kill those Poporings.
You should hunt 10 of them.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
好的，如果你準備好了，就去消滅那些變異波利。
你需要獵殺10只。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Skeletons are basic undead.
Use the Heal or Resurrection skill.
If you can.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
邪骸戰士是基礎亡靈。
使用治癒術或復活術。
如果你會的話。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Just in case I will recover all your energy.
It's the last step so be careful.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
以防萬一，我會恢復你所有的能量。
這是最後一步，請小心。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Did you get back what the Poporing stole?
This cave is really deep and there are lots of precious things that they could have picked up.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
你拿回被變異波利偷走的東西了嗎？
這個洞穴很深，裡面有很多它們可能撿走的珍貴物品。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
You did really great job. Excellent.
The 1st floor is safer now. Thanks for helping.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
你做得非常棒。太出色了。
第一層現在安全多了。謝謝你的幫助。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
You've completed all of the training missions so go back to the headquarters and get approval from the flashy Rune Knight.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
你已完成所有訓練任務，所以回到總部，向那位華麗的盧恩騎士申請批准吧。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
You might get a new uniform.
Haha. I will keep tabs on your progression.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
你可能會得到一套新制服。
哈哈。我會關注你的進步的。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Poporings are stronger than you expect.
If you treat them the same as a normal Poring it will get you in trouble.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
變異波利比你想像的更強。
如果你像對待普通波利那樣對待它們，會惹上麻煩的。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Just in case I will recover all your energy.
It's the last step so be careful.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
以防萬一，我會恢復你所有的能量。
這是最後一步，請小心。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
I already informed Boya at the Eden Group headquarters.
If you go there he will give you a big welcome.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
我已經通知樂園團總部的博雅了。
如果你去那裡，他會給你盛大的歡迎。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
You will get a new uniform, aren't you excited?
Hahaha..
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
你會得到一套新制服，你不興奮嗎？
哈哈哈...

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Killing undead?
Do your best to make the world safer.
It's one of the goals of the Eden Group.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
消滅亡靈？
盡你所能讓世界變得更安全。
這是樂園團的目標之一。

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
Oops.
You are a member of my group.
Why did you come here, are you looking for danger?
scripts.translation:
[克勞德]
哎呀。
你是我的組員。
你怎麼會來這裡，是在尋找危險嗎？

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
One of the strongest boss monsters is in here.
Be careful when exploring here.
scripts.translation:
[克勞德]
這裡有一隻非常強大的首領級魔物。
探索這裡時要小心。

scripts.text:
[Cloud ]
What are you looking at?
We are not related to each other, are we...
scripts.translation:
[克勞德]
你在看什麼？
我們之間沒有血緣關係，對吧...

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
Hello?
Why did you come here, looking for danger?
scripts.translation:
[克勞德]
你好？
你怎麼會來這裡，是在尋找危險嗎？

scripts.text: Conquer Ant Hell
scripts.translation: 征服螞蟻地獄

scripts.text: Just wanted to meet you
scripts.translation: 只是想見見你

scripts.text: Where am I?
scripts.translation: 我在哪裡？

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
Uh. Conquer Ant Hell? Did you say that?
You are a trainee.
You have come to the right place.
scripts.translation:
[克勞德]
嗯。征服螞蟻地獄？你是這麼說的嗎？
你是學員。
你來得正是時候。

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
At first I will explain about Ant Hell.
Ants dug a cave in the sand and it is linked to the surface. That's Ant Hell.
scripts.translation:
[克勞德]
首先我來介紹一下螞蟻地獄。
螞蟻在沙地裡挖了洞穴，並與地面相連。這就是螞蟻地獄。

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
Sand flowed into the hole gradually.
If anyone steps on the hole they will fall into the cave through the hole in the sand..
scripts.translation:
[克勞德]
沙子逐漸流進了洞裡。
如果有人踩到洞上，就會通過沙地上的洞口掉進洞穴裡...

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
It's hard to survive from there.
To us it seems like a normal happening so it isn't a matter of survival like to normal people.
scripts.translation:
[克勞德]
從那裡很難生還。
對我們來說這似乎只是平常發生的事，所以不像普通人那樣關乎生死。

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
Many kinds of ants have come to live here.
There is a boss monster named Maya so you should be more cautious.
scripts.translation:
[克勞德]
許多種類的螞蟻都來此居住。
這裡有一隻名叫蟻后的首領級魔物，所以你要更加小心。

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
Ok let's try to hunt the weakest ant first.
Pierre is the name of the weakest ant.
They are just down here.
scripts.translation:
[克勞德]
好，我們先試著獵殺最弱的螞蟻。
最弱的螞蟻叫白蟻。
它們就在下面。

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
In the case of ants, they assist eachother when attacked.
Be careful and kill 15 Pierre ants.
scripts.translation:
[克勞德]
對於螞蟻來說，被攻擊時會互相幫助。
請小心，獵殺15只白蟻。

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
......
Haha... are you joking?
You are exhausted from the extremely hot weather in the desert.
scripts.translation:
[克勞德]
......
哈哈...你在開玩笑嗎？
你被沙漠裡酷熱的天氣累壞了。

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
I am a busy man.
One of the trainees was planning to visit me but that person still hasn't showed yet. I am getting nervous.
scripts.translation:
[克勞德]
我是個忙碌的人。
有一位學員計劃來拜訪我，但那個人到現在還沒出現。我有點著急了。

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
Where you are?
You are in Anth Hell southwest of Morocc.
Morocc is the closest city, northeast of here.
scripts.translation:
[克勞德]
你在哪裡？
你在莫洛克的西南方，螞蟻地獄。
莫洛克是離這裡最近的城市，在東北方。

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
Hey, what was it?
Maybe you saw an Andre when you were hunting Pierre.
scripts.translation:
[克勞德]
嘿，怎麼了？
也許你在獵殺白蟻時看到了變異晶片。

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
Well, now let's hunt Andre aswel.
Ahah the way you're looking at me, ''why didn't I ask you to do this all at once'' right?
scripts.translation:
[克勞德]
好吧，現在讓我們也獵殺變異晶片。
啊哈，你這樣看著我，是覺得“為什麼不一開始就讓我做這些”對吧？

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
Ain't it more fun this way?
Hey, now your next target is 15 Andre!
You are strong so it will be fine!
scripts.translation:
[克勞德]
這樣不是更有趣嗎？
嘿，你下一個目標是15只變異晶片！
你很強大，所以沒問題的！

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
If you can't find Andre go deeper into the cave.
Ah, and be careful of Maya.
scripts.translation:
[克勞德]
如果找不到白蟻，就往洞穴深處走。
啊，還有，小心蟻后。

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
What do you think of Ant Hell?
Can you stay longer?
Ok, I will recover your strengh so, keep going.
scripts.translation:
[克勞德]
你覺得螞蟻地獄怎麼樣？
能堅持更久嗎？
好的，我會恢復你的體力，繼續加油吧。

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
Great. You seem to have killed all of the Andre.
How do you think about fighting ants?
Was it good?
scripts.translation:
[克勞德]
很好。看來你已經殺光了所有的白蟻。
你覺得打螞蟻的感覺如何？
還順利嗎？

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
Hey, cheer up.
To conquer Ant Hell you have one step left.
You might have guessed your next target already.
scripts.translation:
[克勞德]
嘿，振作一點。
要征服螞蟻地獄，你只剩最後一步了。
你可能已經猜到下一個目標是誰了。

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
Vitata!
How can I say... He seems like honey.
Pierre is a worker. Andre is a guardian and so... Vitata is like a mother.
scripts.translation:
[克勞德]
黑蟻！
該怎麼說呢...它們就像蜂蜜一樣。
工人是Pierre，白蟻是守衛，那麼...黑蟻就像是母親。

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
They are really kind to kids and women but don't show any pity to ants.
Hunt the Vitata who takes care of the ant eggs.
scripts.translation:
[克勞德]
它們對小孩和女性很溫柔，但對螞蟻卻毫不留情。
去獵殺那些照顧螞蟻卵的黑蟻吧。

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
If somebody falls into Ant Hell it might be a bit safer than before.
Now it's the last step so cheer up and let's kill 10 Vitata.
scripts.translation:
[克勞德]
如果有人掉進螞蟻地獄，現在應該比以前安全一點了。
這是最後一步，振作起來，讓我們殺掉10只黑蟻。

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
If you feel you're in too much danger. Just come back.
I will heal you.
scripts.translation:
[克勞德]
如果你覺得危險太大，就回來吧。
我會治癒你。

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
See, to cheer you up I will heal you until you finish the training.
Chin up and cheer up.
scripts.translation:
[克勞德]
看，為了讓你振作起來，我會一直治癒你直到你完成訓練。
抬起頭，振作起來。

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
Oh... it might have been an anoying fight.
You finished so fast.
scripts.translation:
[克勞德]
噢...那場戰鬥可能有點麻煩。
你完成得真快。

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
Good job. Go back to the headquarters and report.
You've completed the training quickly.
scripts.translation:
[克勞德]
幹得好。回到總部彙報吧。
你很快完成了訓練。

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
You will get good news.
You did a really good job even under the hot weather.
scripts.translation:
[克勞德]
你會有好訊息的。
即使在炎熱的天氣下，你也做得非常出色。

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
See, to cheer up I will heal you until you finish the training.
Chin up and cheer up.
scripts.translation:
[克勞德]
看，為了讓你振作起來，我會一直治癒你直到你完成訓練。
抬起頭，振作起來。

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
Just Vitata, isn't that an easy opponent?
If you see Maya just run away.
scripts.translation:
[克勞德]
只有黑蟻，這不是個簡單的對手嗎？
如果你看到蟻后，就趕緊逃跑。

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
It's enough to say that you've conquered Ant Hell.
Aren't you getting used to it here?
scripts.translation:
[克勞德]
可以說你已經征服了螞蟻地獄。
你在這裡是不是已經習慣了？

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
Go back to the headquarters and report that you completed the mission, hurry up
you will receive good news.
You will receive the Eden Group uniform aswel.
scripts.translation:
[克勞德]
回到總部彙報你完成了任務，快點。
你會收到好訊息的。
你還會收到樂園團的制服。

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
I am really proud of the Eden Group.
Does the uniform look good on me?
Haha...
scripts.translation:
[克勞德]
我真的為樂園團感到驕傲。
這制服穿在我身上好看嗎？
哈哈...

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
Unbelievable why did you come here?
Um... You are not on the third step of the training?
Yeeee~ I'm excited~
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
難以置信，你為什麼會來這裡？
嗯...你不是在訓練的第三步嗎？
耶~我好興奮~

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
I am a little bored waiting for trainees. Where are they?
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
等學員的時候我有點無聊。他們在哪？

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
Hello.
Why did you come here?
Umm... Aaaaa...
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
你好。
你為什麼會來這裡？
嗯...啊啊啊...

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
Why don't you join my group?
If you have interest in joining us,
you won't regret your decision.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
為什麼不加入我的隊伍呢？
如果你有興趣加入我們，
你不會後悔這個決定的。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
Hello.
Are you a trainee?
Yeah I can tell.
So shall we begin?
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
你好。
你是學員嗎？
我看得出來。
那麼，我們開始吧？

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
Actually I don't like this training mission much but anyway let me explain it to you.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
其實我不太喜歡這個訓練任務，但無論如何，讓我給你解釋一下。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
As you know this is Orc Village.
Orcs don't like humans.
They don't try to communicate with us. When they see humans they immediately attack us.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
你知道的，這裡是獸人村。
獸人不喜歡人類。
他們不嘗試與我們交流。當他們看到人類時，會立即攻擊我們。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
Sadly humans don't want to communicate with them either.
So we decided to take a strong approach towards them.
Actually we'd like to get rid of them all.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
不幸的是，人類也不想與他們交流。
所以我們決定對他們採取強硬手段。
實際上，我們想消滅他們所有人。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
We're trying to conquer Orc Village.
It's the proper place to finish the beginners training mission for an adventurer like you.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
我們正在嘗試征服獸人村。
這是像你這般的冒險者完成新手訓練任務的合適地點。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
That's why we've chosen this place for this mission.
Ok, we don't have a lot of time so let's begin.
First let's eliminate the weakest one.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
所以我們選擇了這個地方作為任務地點。
好吧，我們沒有太多時間，讓我們開始吧。
首先，讓我們消滅最弱的那個。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
It's better to kill them before they grow up.
Hunt 10 Orc Babies.
Don't pity them because when they grow up they become aggressive Orc Warriors.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
最好在它們長大之前殺掉它們。
獵殺10只獸人寶寶。
不要憐憫它們，因為它們長大後就會變成好戰的獸人戰士。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
Good or bad this is how it is going to be.
Even if they are babies don't hesitate.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
無論好壞，事情就是這樣。
即使是寶寶，也不要猶豫。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
Great. Awesome.
It's not very pleasant so let's move on.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
很好。太棒了。
這並不令人愉快，讓我們繼續吧。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
On the next step we will fight with Orc Warriors.
When Orc Babies grow up they become strong Orc Warriors.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
在下一步，我們將與獸人戰士戰鬥。
當獸人寶寶長大後，它們會變成強大的獸人戰士。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
They all are powerful warriors.
When you were fighting Orc Babies, you probably have been attacked by them.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
它們都是強大的戰士。
當你與獸人寶寶戰鬥時，你可能已經被它們攻擊過了。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
Now it's time to hunt 10 Orc Warriors.
If you are in trouble just come back here to safety.
Do you understand?
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
現在是時候獵殺10只獸人戰士了。
如果你遇到麻煩，就回到這裡安全的地方。
你明白了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
There are Orc Warriors, Orc Ladies and Orc Babies in Orc Village.
They are really aggressive.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
獸人村裡有獸人戰士、獸人女士和獸人寶寶。
它們真的很有攻擊性。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
You look tired I will recover your health.
If you are in trouble just come back here to safety.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
你看起來很累，我會恢復你的生命值。
如果你遇到麻煩，就回到這裡安全的地方。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
Now you can move on to the next step.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
現在你可以進入下一步了。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
Exactly... now it's time to hunt Orc Ladies.
If you want to conquer Orc Village completely, you should kill them before they have more Orc Babies.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
沒錯...現在是時候獵殺獸人女士了。
如果你想完全征服獸人村，你應該在它們生出更多獸人寶寶之前殺掉它們。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
But you don't need to kill all of them.
Go and hunt 10 Orc Ladies.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
但你不需要殺掉它們所有。
去獵殺10只獸人女士。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
You can already feel the strong power from outside...
Don't hesitate to attack them.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
你已經能感覺到外面強大的力量了...
不要猶豫攻擊它們。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
You should be exhausted by now.
But you still have more targets, understand.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
你現在應該很疲憊了。
但你還有更多的目標，明白嗎。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
You look tired, I will recover your health.
If you are in trouble just come back here to safety.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
你看起來很疲憊，我來幫你恢復體力。
如果遇到危險，隨時回來這裡避難。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
Great job.
Now you should understand how the orc tribe works here in Orc Village.
You've followed the training mission well under hot and humid circumstances.
You have now completed the 'Conquer Orc Village!' training mission. Congratulations.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
幹得不錯。
現在你應該瞭解這裡獸人村的運作方式了。
你在炎熱潮溼的環境下很好地完成了訓練任務。
你已完成“征服獸人村！”訓練任務。恭喜。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
Go back and report to the Eden Group headquarters.
I'm sure they will have good news for you.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
回去向樂園團總部彙報吧。
我相信他們會給你帶來好訊息。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
Orc Lady is the last target.
Cheer up~!
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
獸人女士是最後一個目標。
加油~！

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
You look tired, I will recover your health.
If you are in trouble just come back here to safety.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
你看起來很疲憊，我來幫你恢復體力。
如果遇到危險，隨時回來這裡避難。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
You have completed the training mission.
Go back to the Eden Group headquarters and report there.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
你已完成訓練任務。
回到樂園團總部並在那裡彙報。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
Have you come here to join in the training?
You look like an expert.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
你是來這裡參加訓練的嗎？
你看起來很有經驗。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
This isn't a good place to talk so let's hurry.
This place is linked with the dungeon of Orc Village.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
這裡不適合閒聊，我們快走吧。
這個地方與獸人村的地下城相連。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
Can you see that way.
There is a cave under the ground, normal orcs don't come here.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
你能看到那邊嗎。
地下有一個洞穴，普通的獸人不會來這裡。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
The safest place is in here.
There are many undead monsters down there.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
這裡是最安全的地方。
下面有很多不死系魔物。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
The undead monsters are dangerous and threatening.
Don't hesitate when fighting them.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
不死系魔物危險且具威脅性。
戰鬥時不要猶豫。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
Now hunt those undead monsters down there.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
現在去獵殺下面那些不死系魔物。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
Try to hunt 20 Orc zombies in the dungeon.
They are really well organized.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
試著在地下城里獵殺20只獸人腐屍。
它們組織得很嚴密。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
They will attack you anywhere without hesitating.
May Freya bless you.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
它們會毫不猶豫地攻擊你。
願芙蕾雅保佑你。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
It's different from what you saw in Payon, right?
Although you managed to kill the Orc Zombies, you can't be sure you are much stronger..
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
這和你在斐揚看到的不同，對吧？
雖然你殺死了獸人腐屍，但你不能確定自己是否真的變強了。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
So don't go deeper into that cave or you will die for sure.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
所以不要深入那個洞穴，否則你肯定會死。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
The next target is the Orc Skeleton who was walking next to the Orc Zombies.
Hunt 20 Orc Skeletons.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
下一個目標是走在獸人腐屍旁邊的邪骸獸人。
獵殺20只邪骸獸人。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
It's the last step of the training mission in the Orc Dungeon.
It's all up to you.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
這是獸人地下城訓練任務的最後一步。
一切取決於你。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
Ok, cheer up and see you again.
Hunt 20 Orc Skeletons.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
好的，加油，回頭見。
獵殺20只邪骸獸人。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
Can you stay longer?
You look tired, I will recover your health.
If you are in trouble just come back here to safety.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
你能再待一會兒嗎？
你看起來很疲憊，我來幫你恢復體力。
如果遇到危險，隨時回來這裡避難。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
Your training mission has been completed.
Go back to the Eden Group headquarters and report.
I would like to say more in detail but I'm getting so tired.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
你的訓練任務已完成。
回到樂園團總部並彙報。
我想說得更詳細些，但我太累了。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
Recently trainees have come here more and more so, I can't sleep at all.
I mean not due to you.
Anyway I will inform the group so go there and report.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
最近學員越來越多，我完全睡不著覺。
當然，這不是你的錯。
總之我會通知團裡的，你去那邊彙報吧。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
Can you stay longer?
You look tired I will recover your health.
If you are in trouble just come back here to safety.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
你能再待一會兒嗎？
你看起來很疲憊，我來幫你恢復體力。
如果遇到危險，隨時回來這裡避難。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
Don't you have to report back to the Eden Group headquarters?
I am so tired leave me alone.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
你難道不應該回樂園團總部彙報嗎？
我太累了，別打擾我。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
Uh? What Orc? Explore the dungeon?
You are having such a hard time.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
啊？什麼獸人？探索地下城？
你真是夠辛苦的。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
This place is really good to take a rest because Orcs don't come here.
Ho hum...
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
這裡很適合休息，因為獸人不會來這裡。
呼...

scripts.text:
[Callandiva]
How did you get so deep in this ocean city?
Ah, that symbol is of our group.
You're a trainee for sure.
scripts.translation:
[卡蘭蒂瓦]
你是怎麼來到海底城市這麼深處的？
啊，那個標誌是我們團的。
你肯定是學員吧。

scripts.text:
[Callandiva]
What? You aren't?
I... see... I see...
Ok... keep going.
scripts.translation:
[卡蘭蒂瓦]
什麼？你不是？
我...明白了...明白了...
好吧...繼續前進吧。

scripts.text:
[Callandiva]
Mysteriously although we're under the sea you can still breathe here.
Do you know why?
scripts.translation:
[卡蘭蒂瓦]
奇怪的是，雖然我們在海底，但這裡依然可以呼吸。
你知道為什麼嗎？

scripts.text:
[Callandiva]
Let's see due to the moisture my skin is so soft.
My fingers and toes are not attached to each other amazing.
scripts.translation:
[卡蘭蒂瓦]
讓我看看，因為溼度大，我的皮膚變得很柔軟。
我的手指和腳趾都沒有連在一起，真神奇。

scripts.text:
[Callandiva]
I was really shocked and scared when the Eden Group dispatched me here.
Now I love this environment so much.
It's really calm...
scripts.translation:
[卡蘭蒂瓦]
當初樂園團派我來這裡時，我真的又震驚又害怕。
但現在我非常喜歡這裡的環境。
這裡真的很安靜...

scripts.text:
[Callandiva]
How did you get so deep in this ocean city?
Ah, that symbol is of our group.
You're a trainee for sure.
scripts.translation:
[卡蘭蒂瓦]
你是怎麼來到海底城市這麼深處的？
啊，那個標誌是我們團的。
你肯定是學員吧。

scripts.text:
[Callandiva]
Good to see you!
Alright, look down.
Ancient buildings are sleeping under the water. They were actually built under the sea.
scripts.translation:
[卡蘭蒂瓦]
見到你真好！
好了，往下看。
水下沉睡著一座座古老的建築。它們其實是在海底建造的。

scripts.text:
[Callandiva]
As you know we don't have any trouble living here.
But if you see over there... yes right there.
scripts.translation:
[卡蘭蒂瓦]
你知道的，我們在這裡生活沒有任何困難。
但是如果你看那邊...對，就在那裡。

scripts.text:
[Callandiva]
Can you see a humanoid fish with a very threatening spear?
He is called a Merman and is a really professional warrior.
scripts.translation:
[卡蘭蒂瓦]
你能看到一個拿著極具威脅性長矛的人形魚嗎？
他被稱為人魚士兵，是一名非常專業的戰士。

scripts.text:
[Callandiva]
Okay, go and hunt 15 Merman.
That will be your 1st training mission here.
scripts.translation:
[卡蘭蒂瓦]
好的，去獵殺15個人魚士兵。
這將是你在這裡的第一個訓練任務。

scripts.text:
[Callandiva]
Oh, you came back~!
What did you think of those threatening Mermans?
Actually, I thought that you would chicken out~
scripts.translation:
[卡蘭蒂瓦]
哦，你回來了~！
你覺得那些威脅性很強的人魚士兵怎麼樣？
其實，我以為你會嚇得逃跑~

scripts.text:
[Callandiva]
Good your next opponent will be...~
Yes, this one...
The monster that is holding a trident.
scripts.translation:
[卡蘭蒂瓦]
很好，你的下一個對手是...~
是的，就是它...
那個拿著三叉戟的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Callandiva]
His main abilities are magical.
The monster is called Strouf!
Now, it's time to fight with a real magician!
scripts.translation:
[卡蘭蒂瓦]
它的主要能力是魔法。
這個魔物叫做海神！
現在，是時候和真正的魔法師戰鬥了！

scripts.text:
[Callandiva]
Try avoiding the Mermans and hunt 10 Strouf, kill them.
scripts.translation:
[卡蘭蒂瓦]
試著避開人魚士兵，獵殺10只海神，消滅它們。

scripts.text:
[Callandiva]
Oh are you tired?
Mermans are not easy opponents.
I will help you recover so cheer up.
scripts.translation:
[卡蘭蒂瓦]
哦，你累了嗎？
人魚士兵可不是容易對付的對手。
我會幫你恢復體力，加油。

scripts.text:
[Callandiva]
Did you kill all the Strouf already?
I wasn't counting that you'd make it.
I have eyes on the top of my head haha.
scripts.translation:
[卡蘭蒂瓦]
你已經把所有海神都殺完了？
我沒想到你能做到。
我真是瞎了眼，哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Callandiva]
Of course I'm just kidding.
Don't look at me like that~ it was a joke~!
Now you're feeling more at ease about this.
scripts.translation:
[卡蘭蒂瓦]
我當然是在開玩笑啦。
別那樣看著我嘛~ 那是個玩笑~！
現在你應該感覺輕鬆多了吧。

scripts.text:
[Callandiva]
Go back to the headquarters and report it.~
You will receive the last uniform from the Eden Group headquarters.
scripts.translation:
[卡蘭蒂瓦]
回到總部彙報一下吧。~
你會從樂園團總部領取最後一套制服。

scripts.text:
[Callandiva]
This training mission is made for beginners.
So it might be useless to you or not.
scripts.translation:
[卡蘭蒂瓦]
這個訓練任務是為初學者準備的。
所以對你來說可能沒什麼用，也可能很有用。

scripts.text:
[Callandiva]
Anyway you did great job!
scripts.translation:
[卡蘭蒂瓦]
總之，你做得非常棒！

scripts.text:
[Callandiva]
Oh are you tired?
Strouf are not easy opponents.
I can help you recover so cheer up.
scripts.translation:
[卡蘭蒂瓦]
哦，你累了嗎？
海神可不是容易對付的對手。
我可以幫你恢復體力，加油。

scripts.text:
[Callandiva]
I won't give help to you anymore.
Go back to our headquarters and report about this training mission.
scripts.translation:
[卡蘭蒂瓦]
我不會再給你幫助了。
回到我們的總部，彙報一下這個訓練任務的情況吧。

scripts.text:
[Callandiva]
Mysteriously although we're under the sea you can still breathe here.
Do you know why?
scripts.translation:
[卡蘭蒂瓦]
奇怪的是，雖然我們在海底，但這裡依然可以呼吸。
你知道為什麼嗎？

scripts.translation:

讓我看看，因為溼度大，我的皮膚變得很柔軟。
我的手指和腳趾都沒有連在一起，真神奇。

scripts.text:

It's really calm...
scripts.translation:
[卡蘭蒂瓦]
當初樂園團派我來這裡時，我真的又震驚又害怕。
但現在我非常喜歡這裡的環境。
這裡真的很安靜...

scripts.text:
[Michael]
Why did you come here?
scripts.translation:
[邁克爾]
你為什麼來這裡？

scripts.text: To get supplies
scripts.translation: 領取補給

scripts.text: Where is here?
scripts.translation: 這是哪裡？

scripts.text: Upgrade equipment
scripts.translation: 升級裝備

scripts.text:
[Michael]
If you've completed step 1
we can supply you with a Eden Group Hat, Uniform, Manteau and Boots.
^4d4dffCheck your inventory first.^000000
scripts.translation:
[邁克爾]
如果你完成了第一步，
我們可以為你提供樂園團圓帽、制服、斗篷和靴子。
^4d4dff請先檢查你的背包空間。^000000

scripts.text:
[Michael]
If you've completed step 2, we offer extra weapons including the basic equipment.
scripts.translation:
[邁克爾]
如果你完成了第二步，我們提供額外的武器，包括基礎裝備。

scripts.text:
[Michael]
You've completed the last training course.
It's time for you to receive a new weapon.
scripts.translation:
[邁克爾]
你完成了最後的訓練課程。
是時候領取新武器了。

scripts.text:
[Michael]
Wait...I will check the record...
...
...hummmm.
scripts.translation:
[邁克爾]
等等...我要查一下記錄...
...
...嗯嗯。

scripts.text:
[Michael]
We store weapons, armor and other goods which were created by the Eden Group here.
We also have a lot of special stuff.
scripts.translation:
[邁克爾]
我們在這裡存放由樂園團製造的武器、防具和其他物品。
我們還有很多特殊物品。

scripts.text:
[Michael]
You mean upgrading equipment, right?
We can only upgrade the Eden Group Hat.
scripts.translation:
[邁克爾]
你是說升級裝備，對吧？
我們只能升級樂園團圓帽。

scripts.text: [Michael]
scripts.translation: [邁克爾]

scripts.text: Let me check my inventory
scripts.translation: 讓我檢查一下背包

scripts.text: I have enough room.
scripts.translation: 我有足夠的空間

scripts.text:
[Michael]
Make sure you have enough room for the supplies.
scripts.translation:
[邁克爾]
請確保你有足夠的空間來存放補給品。

scripts.text:
[Michael]
Two of the supplies, the ^4d4dffHat and Manteau^000000,
will only be given out once.
So treat them with caution and care.
scripts.translation:
[邁克爾]
其中兩件補給品，^4d4dff圓帽和斗篷^000000，
只會發放一次。
所以請謹慎對待並妥善保管。

scripts.text:
[Michael]
As for the Boots and the Uniforms, you will receive better quality ones based on your course grades.
scripts.translation:
[邁克爾]
至於長靴和制服，您將根據課程成績獲得質量更好的款式。

scripts.text:

One Eden Group Hat.
One Eden Group Uniform I.
One pair of Eden Group Boots I.
One Eden Group Manteau.
A total of 4 supplies, that's all.
scripts.translation:
[邁克爾]
一件樂園團圓帽。
一件樂園團制服 Ⅰ。
一雙樂園團短靴 Ⅰ。
一件樂園團斗篷。
總共4件補給品，僅此而已。

scripts.text:
[Michael]
Is that correct?
It is manufactured for beginners so they don't have the best effect but they're still cheaper than equipment in the shops.
scripts.translation:
[邁克爾]
是這樣嗎？
這些是為初學者製造的，雖然效果不是最好，但比商店裡的裝備要便宜。

scripts.text:
[Michael]
We made them especially for the Eden Group.
scripts.translation:
[邁克爾]
我們專門為樂園團製作了這些裝備。

scripts.text:
[Michael]
We have chosen the proper weapon for each class.
But we can't support some classes that can't join us.
scripts.translation:
[邁克爾]
我們為每個職業選擇了合適的武器。
但我們無法支援那些無法加入我們的一些職業。

scripts.text:
[Michael]
We can't manufacture all of the weapons in the world, don't you agree?
scripts.translation:
[邁克爾]
我們不可能製造世界上所有的武器，您覺得呢？

scripts.text:
[Michael]
We will supply 1 Weapon, Shoes and Uniform so a total of three things.
Also we supply extra things to consider some members who can't use some of the supplies.
scripts.translation:
[邁克爾]
我們將提供1件武器、長靴和制服，總共三樣東西。
此外，考慮到有些成員無法使用某些補給品，我們也會提供額外的物品。

scripts.text:
[Michael]
^4d4dffPlease check your inventory to get those items.^000000
scripts.translation:
[邁克爾]
^4d4dff請檢查您的背包以領取這些物品。^000000

scripts.translation: 我會騰出更多空間。

scripts.translation: 我有足夠的空間。

[Michael]
Make enough space.
scripts.translation:

請騰出足夠的空間。

scripts.translation: [邁克爾]

scripts.text:

Let me see... you will receive..
the Eden Group Boots II and Uniform II.
scripts.translation:

讓我看看...您將獲得...

scripts.text:

the Eden Group Boots II and Uniform II.
scripts.translation:
讓我看看...您將獲得...
樂園團短靴 Ⅱ和制服 Ⅱ。

scripts.text:

I don't know what weapon will suit you so, you'll get a Dagger.
You don't have a record of receiving any supplies
so, you'll receive the Eden Group Hat and Manteau aswell.
scripts.translation:
[邁克爾]
我不知道什麼武器適合您，所以您將獲得一把短劍。
由於您沒有領取補給品的記錄，
您還將獲得樂園團圓帽和斗篷。

scripts.text:
[Michael]
A Weapon, Uniform and Boots all 3 supplies.
I don't know what weapon will suit you so, you'll get a Dagger.
Please check it again.
scripts.translation:
[邁克爾]
武器、制服和長靴，總共3件補給品。
我不知道什麼武器適合您，所以您將獲得一把短劍。
請再次確認。

scripts.text:
[Michael]
Check your supplies again and look after it.
scripts.translation:
[邁克爾]
再次檢查您的補給品並妥善保管。

scripts.text:
[Michael]
I hope they're useful to you.
scripts.translation:
[邁克爾]
希望它們對您有用。

scripts.text:
[Michael]
We have more upgraded weapons, uniforms and boots.
Ah, in case of the weapon that was made only for 1st jobs.
So, I can't offer them to higher jobs.
scripts.translation:
[邁克爾]
我們有更多升級後的武器、制服和長靴。
啊，不過那些武器是專門為1級職業製作的。
所以我無法提供給更高等級的職業。

scripts.text:
[Michael]
^4d4dffPlease check you inventory to get those supplies.^000000
scripts.translation:
[邁克爾]
^4d4dff請檢查您的背包以領取這些補給品。^000000

scripts.translation: 我稍後再來。

scripts.translation: 我有足夠的空間

Make sure you have enough room.

scripts.translation: [邁克爾]

scripts.text:
Let me see... you will receive..
the Eden Group Boots III and Uniform III.
scripts.translation:
讓我看看...您將獲得...
樂園團短靴 Ⅲ和制服 Ⅲ。

scripts.text:

You don't have a record of receiving any supplies
so, you'll receive the Eden Group Hat and Manteau aswell.
scripts.translation:

您沒有領取過任何補給品的記錄，
所以您還將獲得樂園團圓帽和斗篷。

scripts.text:
[Michael]
A Uniform and Boots all 2 supplies.
Please check it again.
scripts.translation:
[邁克爾]
制服和長靴，總共2件補給品。
請再次確認。

scripts.text:
[Michael]
Check your supplies again and look after it.
scripts.translation:
[邁克爾]
再次檢查您的補給品並妥善保管。

scripts.text:
[Michael]
I hope they're useful to you.
scripts.translation:
[邁克爾]
希望它們對您有用。

scripts.text:
[Michael]
Sorry, but I can't find any record that you can obtain supplies.
Are you sure?
scripts.translation:
[邁克爾]
抱歉，我找不到您可以領取補給品的記錄。
您確定嗎？

scripts.text:
[Michael]
To prepare for emergencies, we hav enough equipment and supplies for an entire army.
Frankly... we don't have a use for it now but in case soemthing happens like in Morocc.
scripts.translation:
[邁克爾]
為了應對緊急情況，我們儲備了足以裝備一支軍隊的裝備和補給品。
老實說...我們現在用不上它們，但以防發生像莫洛克那樣的事情。

scripts.text:
[Michael]
Just take a look around and don't touch anything.
scripts.translation:
[邁克爾]
請四處看看，但不要觸碰任何東西。

scripts.text:
[Michael]
If I make a mistake, Reke will punish me.
scripts.translation:
[邁克爾]
如果我犯了錯，雷克會懲罰我的。

scripts.text:
[Michael]
What status bonus do you want to upgrade?
scripts.translation:
[邁克爾]
您想升級哪項狀態加成？

First come with a Hat that you want me to upgrade.

scripts.translation:

請先帶著您想要升級的帽子過來。

You haven't received all the supplies up to step 3.

您還沒有領取完第3階段的所有補給品。

scripts.translation:

為什麼？升級後效果會更好。
不過，我們只能為您提供一頂帽子。

scripts.text:
[Michael]
What you do with it is up to you.
scripts.translation:
[邁克爾]
至於您如何使用它，那就由您自己決定了。

scripts.translation:
請先帶上一頂您想要升級的帽子。

scripts.translation:

我們只能提供1次升級服務。
抱歉，我無法為您進行兩次升級。

scripts.text:
[Michael]
Sorry but I can't help you.
scripts.translation:

抱歉，我無法幫助您。

scripts.translation:

scripts.translation:

scripts.translation:

scripts.translation:

scripts.translation:

完成這些任務後，我會給你相當不錯的獎勵。

scripts.text:

Yeah!
Ok, let me check what mission you should get ok?
scripts.translation:

太好了！
好，讓我看看該給你分配什麼任務。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
Well... I know that you've got the heart but you're just a little too weak to help.
scripts.translation:
[指導員 烏爾]
嗯...我知道你有勇氣，但你現在的實力還太弱，幫不上忙。

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

好，看來你剛好達到這些任務的最低等級要求。

scripts.translation:

以你的等級，克魔島對你來說太簡單了。
沒錯，就是這裡。

scripts.text:

Ah, ok so for you...

scripts.translation:
[指導員 烏爾]
啊，好的，至於你...
嗯，我該把你派到哪裡呢？

scripts.text: [Instructor Ur]
scripts.translation: [指導員 烏爾]

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
Sorry, but your basic level should be at least 60 to help with these missions.
scripts.translation:
[指導員 烏爾]
抱歉，你的基礎等級至少需要60級才能參與這些任務。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
Based on your level, I think that the Comodo area suits you.
scripts.translation:
[指導員 烏爾]
根據你的等級，我覺得克魔島適合你。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
Do you know where Comodo is?
You can get there by going to Morocc and then through Pharos Lighthouse.
scripts.translation:
[指導員 烏爾]
你知道克魔島在哪裡嗎？
你可以先去莫洛克，然後經過發樂斯燈塔島到達那裡。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
Comodo is a small city on the coast with many caves.
scripts.translation:
[指導員 烏爾]
克魔島是海岸邊的一座小城，那裡有很多洞穴。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
Look for the cave located to the north. There's someone there named Romeo.
You know? As in Romeo, Romeo, wherefore art thou Romeo.
scripts.translation:
[指導員 烏爾]
去找北邊的洞穴，那裡有個叫羅密歐的人。
知道吧？就是羅密歐，羅密歐，你為何是羅密歐。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
Go there are get the mission from him.
Well, then come back here alive when you're done!
scripts.translation:
[指導員 烏爾]
去那裡從他那裡接任務。
好了，完成後活著回來找我！

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
Do you know where Glast Heim is?
If there was a tragic accident now, the capital of the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom could revert back to there.
scripts.translation:
[指導員 烏爾]
你知道葛拉斯特海姆在哪裡嗎？
如果現在發生悲劇事故，盧恩·米德加茲王國的首都可能會遷回那裡。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
Well, if it wasn't infested with undead monsters, it would become the new capitol of Rune-Midgarts.
scripts.translation:
[指導員 烏爾]
要是那裡沒有亡靈魔物肆虐，它本來就會成為盧恩·米德加茲的新首都。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
Please, come back alive.
scripts.translation:
[指導員 烏爾]
請務必活著回來。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
There an industrial city called Einbroch.
You know it? It's a city covered in smog.
It's a pretty gloomy city come to think of it.
scripts.translation:
[指導員 烏爾]
那裡有一座叫艾音布羅克的工業城市。
你知道嗎？那是一座被煙霧籠罩的城市。
仔細想想，那地方還挺陰森的。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
Anyways, go to Einbroch and find the Dispatched Instructor there. He should be in the field south of the main city.
scripts.translation:
[指導員 烏爾]
總之，去艾音布羅克找那裡的派遣指導員。他應該在主城南邊的野外。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
We have rewards for you.
I'm sure Romeo gave you some items, but we brought more useful things.
scripts.translation:
[指導員 烏爾]
我們有獎勵給你。
羅密歐應該已經給了你一些物品，但我們帶來了更有用的東西。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
Do you know where the weapon storage is at?
Go out through that large blue door and walk to the end of the hallway.
Ask the Blacksmith, and he will give you new equipment.
scripts.translation:
[指導員 烏爾]
你知道武器倉庫在哪裡嗎？
穿過那扇巨大的藍色大門，走到走廊盡頭。
問問鐵匠，他會給你新的裝備。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
And the 2nd stage training and missions start at level 70, so come back then.
Don't forget, I'll be waiting for you.
scripts.translation:
[指導員 烏爾]
而且二轉訓練和任務從70級開始，到時候再回來吧。
別忘了，我會在這裡等你。

哪個地點適合你呢...？

scripts.text: [Instructor Ur]

總之，那座古老的城堡現在充滿了亡靈魔物。
尤其是南邊修道院附近的情況特別糟糕。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
All of those undead monsters come from the underground graveyard

scripts.translation:

那些亡靈魔物都來自地下的墓園。
嗯...我想你不需要一直深入到墓園裡面去...

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

請務必活著回來。

scripts.translation:

鐵匠BK說他會強化你的武器。

scripts.text:

By the way, it looked like Michael had something to tell you as well
Go talk to him, he's at the weapon storage as well.
Go ahead.
scripts.translation:
[指導員 烏爾]
順便說一句，看起來邁克爾也有話要對你說。
去和他談談，他也在武器倉庫。
去吧。

I'm sure he'll reward you for your time.
scripts.translation:
[指導員 烏爾]
另外，邁克爾有時候需要幫忙，如果你有時間的話，試著幫幫他。
我相信他會回報你的時間的。

scripts.text:

I just realized... this was your first mission, wasn't it?
You must not have gotten the basic equipments yet, right?
Pick them up at the weapon storage.
Ask the Blacksmith Michael and he'll give you the equipment.
scripts.translation:
[指導員 烏爾]
我剛才才意識到...這是你的第一個任務，對吧？
你肯定還沒拿到基礎裝備，對吧？
去武器倉庫領取。
問問鐵匠邁克爾，他會給你裝備的。

scripts.text:

Didn't I tell you to go there?
Go there first and then come back to me. Okay?
scripts.translation:
那麼，你去過^4d4dff{0}^000000了嗎？
我不是讓你去那裡嗎？
先去那裡，然後再回來找我。好嗎？

scripts.text:
Hmm.. Not bad ...
You must be getting a hang of this..
Let's go with a simple mission this time
scripts.translation:
嗯...不錯...
看來你已經掌握要領了。
這次我們做個簡單的任務吧。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
There is a industrial city called Einbroch.

You'll appreciate the environment here so much more after visiting that city...
We should all be thankful.
scripts.translation:
[指導員 烏爾]
有一個叫艾音布羅克的工業城市。

去過那個城市後，你會更加珍惜這裡的環境...
我們都應該心存感激。

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

別忘了帶上樂園團的徽章。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]

But the surrounding fields are relatively clean...
This should be pretty easy for you.
scripts.translation:
[指導員 烏爾]
城市的汙染令人難以忍受
但周圍的野外相對乾淨...
這對你來說應該很容易。

scripts.text:

Hmm...

scripts.translation:

嗯...

scripts.translation:
[指導員 烏爾]
拉赫城市北邊有一個充滿冰的洞穴。
在那裡找到派遣指導員。

scripts.text:
Well, well...
I don't even know where to send you now.
I'm sure you are familiar with most places around here
scripts.translation:
哎呀...
我現在都不知道該派你去哪了。
我想你對這裡的大部分地區都很熟悉吧。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
Then, should I send you somewhere farther this time?
There is a Cat Paw Agent here.
Do you see him over there?
scripts.translation:
[指導員 烏爾]
那麼，這次我應該把你派到更遠的地方嗎？
這裡有一位貓爪特工。

scripts.text:

Since there is a Expedition Camp there...
scripts.translation:

通過他，你可以很容易地到達阿什真空。
因為那裡有一個遠征營地...

scripts.translation:

你可以探索新世界
這就像度假一樣，不是嗎？
